screenshots.caption: Cover: the Leonida Legend tracker with the progress bar at 13 of 55 earned, the Chapter 1 missable warning, the six-stage platinum roadmap and the start of the checklist with filters and the spoiler setting visible.
A trophy guide open: Positive Mental Attitude with its full guide, the Chapter 1 missable warning, its target count and its cited sources beside the checklist.
The missable filter on: only Positive Mental Attitude is shown, flagged MISSABLE, with its guide and sources.
Spoiler-safe mode on: hidden story trophies show as Hidden story trophy with their descriptions masked until earned, while earned ones stay visible.
